explanation: Victor Hugo set his novel in 1482 but published it in 1831, 13 years after Mary Shelley's Frankenstein. Its French title is simply Notre-Dame de Paris.

claims.text: Victor Hugo's The Hunchback of Notre-Dame (Notre-Dame de Paris) was first published in 1831.
Mary Shelley's Frankenstein was first published in 1818.
The Hunchback of Notre-Dame is set in 1482.
The novel's original French title is Notre-Dame de Paris.
